title: Space weather dependence of decameter-scale ionospheric irregularities spatial distribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.29630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper describes an approach to constructing nowcast and forecast predictive models for the occurrence of high-latitude decameter ionospheric irregularities based on SuperDARN and SECIRA radar data and space weather parameters. The method relies on self-learning pattern recognition in the dynamics of space weather parameters, that influence the irregularities formation. The proposed approach is a data-driven, multiscale method in which the spatial distribution of irregularities is approximated using a neural network of an original architecture, inspired by graph neural networks.   The model was trained and tested using data from 11 radars during the period 2010-2025 (SuperDARN: CVW, ICE, ICW, INV, PGR, PYK, RKN, SAS, STO; SECIRA: EKB, MAGW). translated_title: 十米尺度电离层不均匀体空间分布对空间天气的依赖性
translated_abstract: 本文描述了一种基于SuperDARN和SECIRA雷达数据以及空间天气参数，构建高纬度十米尺度电离层不均匀体发生的即时预报和预测模型的方法。该方法依赖于对影响不均匀体形成的空间天气参数动态变化的自学习模式识别。所提出的方法是一种数据驱动的多尺度方法，其中不均匀体的空间分布通过一种受图神经网络启发的原创架构神经网络来逼近。该模型使用2010-2025年期间11部雷达的数据进行了训练和测试（SuperDARN：CVW、ICE、ICW、INV、PGR、PYK、RKN、SAS、STO；SECIRA：EKB、MAGW）。结果表明，当使用地磁坐标MLT、MLAT时，模型达到最优性能。在所研究的参数集合中，获得最佳即时预报和预测的最优参数组合为……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于SuperDARN和SECIRA雷达数据与空间天气参数、采用受图神经网络启发的原创神经网络架构的数据驱动多尺度方法，用于高纬度十米尺度电离层不均匀体空间分布的即时预报和预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven, multiscale approach using an original graph-neural-network-inspired neural architecture, based on SuperDARN and SECIRA radar data and space weather parameters, to nowcast and forecast the spatial distribution of high-latitude decameter-scale ionospheric irregularities.
